chunks: Hisham ibn al-Hakam narrated from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:
There is no harm in the pleasant fragrance between al-Safa and al-Marwah from the scent of the perfumers, and he should not hold his nose.

key_terms.الصَّفَا: al-Safa, one of the two well-known stations of sa'y
key_terms.الْمَرْوَةِ: al-Marwah, the other station of sa'y
key_terms.رِيحِ الْعَطَّارِينَ: the scent coming from the perfumers
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or legal problem
key_terms.يُمْسِكُ عَلَى أَنْفِهِ: he covers or holds his nose

ai.seo_question: Is a muhrim allowed to smell perfume between Safa and Marwah?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling for the muhrim during hajj or 'umrah: incidental pleasant fragrance encountered between al-Safa and al-Marwah from perfumers is excused. It also instructs that one should not cover or hold the nose on account of such unavoidable scent.
